objective: Define the next signed-environment execution as an ordered, review-only, rerunnable desired state. The generated diagnostic bundle may run only inside signed Confidential Space after self-custodied authority binding; this plan never claims an independent evaluator.

unknown_value_policy.local_observation_rule: A local digest may be recorded only under read_only_inventory and must not satisfy a production input.
unknown_value_policy.secret_rule: No credentials, tokens, private keys, truth, or signed assertions may be stored in this plan.

operations.desired_state_operation: Bind the exact candidate Confidential Space image reference to one immutable sha256 digest in the existing p5-cs repository and propagate that digest to the WIP condition, authority claim contract, Cloud Run manifest, metadata, and execution request.

exact_required_inputs.name: candidate_image_digest
exact_required_inputs.source: REQUIRED_INPUT:registry digest resolved by reviewed image provenance

exact_required_inputs.name: target_region
exact_required_inputs.source: REQUIRED_INPUT:reviewed Artifact Registry and Cloud Run region

exact_required_inputs.name: target_repository
exact_required_inputs.source: RS-069R5 read-only observation: existing approved Artifact Registry repository

preconditions: RS-040 native definition and RS-060 bundle validate in blocked mode without drift.
The candidate repository is exactly the read-only-observed existing us-east1/p5-cs repository; the nonexistent us-east1/p5 repository is rejected.
Candidate digest is obtained from the reviewed registry/provenance record, never inferred from a tag or local image.
candidate_image_digest is not equal to either workspace-only local closure observation unless independently reviewed as the production artifact.
Master approval for the new RS-069R6 operation-1 request is present; the failed RS-069 attempt approval is not reusable.
expected_postconditions: Every downstream desired-state reference uses the same exact candidate_image_digest.
A tag-only image reference, mutable tag, or digest mismatch is rejected.
No registry, image, VM, or deployment mutation is performed by this plan.
operations.approval_gate: APPROVAL_REQUIRED:master approves a new RS-069R6 operation-1 request for the exact p5-cs repository, candidate digest, and provenance; the failed APPROVAL-001 attempt is not reusable; no approval means no-op.
stop_conditions: Missing, malformed, mutable, or conflicting image digest.
Digest is present only in local preflight inventory with no reviewed production provenance.
Any attempt to push, pull, retag, create, or replace an image.
rollback_conditions: If downstream rendering observes a different image digest, discard the proposed render and restore the prior unmodified definition.
If an approved IaC apply later creates a mismatched revision, halt execution and roll back through the approved IaC workflow; do not repair by direct mutation.

rerunnable.existing_match: no-op when the reviewed desired binding and digest already match
rerunnable.drift: fail closed on any existing mismatch

operations.desired_state_operation: Replace the observed incomplete WIP/provider mapping with the closed mapping and condition required by the attested token contract; keep token audience distinct from the provider resource.

exact_required_inputs.name: attested_project_zone_and_image
exact_required_inputs.source: REQUIRED_INPUT:claims from one real token issued by the exact candidate image

preconditions: Exact provider resource and audience are separately identified; provider is never used as the token audience.
Candidate image digest from operation 1 is available and appears in the condition.
The RS-068 observed mapping omission is reviewed; no existing provider mutation is assumed.
Master/security approval is present.
expected_postconditions: Mapping includes google.subject plus image, project ID/number, zone, debug state, TEE, hardware model, secure boot, workload, and smoke attributes.
Condition binds issuer, audience, image digest, project, zone, debug-disabled, Confidential Space TEE, hardware model, secure boot, evaluator workload, smoke=false, and the attested subject prefix.
Rendered policy is closed and contains no REPLACE_, PROJECT_, POOL, PROVIDER, LOCATION, VERSION, or REQUIRED_INPUT marker.

immutable_digests.name: wip_policy_template_digest
immutable_digests.source: REQUIRED_INPUT:reviewed source verification digest for wip-provider-policy.cel.tmpl

operations.approval_gate: APPROVAL_REQUIRED:security/master approves the exact provider, mapping, condition, and claim-path record; no approval means no-op.
stop_conditions: Provider resource is noncanonical, missing, or confused with the token audience.
Any required claim path or condition term is absent, unknown, or derived from a local test token.
Any direct IAM/WIP API call is proposed by the plan.
rollback_conditions: If rendered mapping or condition differs from the approved contract, discard the render and retain the prior policy definition.
If an applied provider state cannot be proven to match the approved fingerprint, stop and revert through approved IaC state; never broaden the condition to recover.

rerunnable.existing_match: no-op when provider desired state fingerprint matches
rerunnable.drift: fail closed on mismatch or unknown remote state

operations.desired_state_operation: Bind the self-custodied authority metadata to one reviewed Ed25519 KMS key version and prepare, but do not execute, the exact unsigned-lock signing request.

exact_required_inputs.name: kms_key_version
exact_required_inputs.source: REQUIRED_INPUT:reviewed evaluator KMS EC_SIGN_ED25519 key version

preconditions: Unsigned lock request digest is exactly sha256:4fc80599aa0cc99881983cdb1270720de6d5c3f99c47701cf471da409d29a3df.
Authority and KMS public key digest agree; private key material is absent.
The binding is self-custodied and diagnostic/non-release; no independent evaluator is required or claimed.
Confidential Space approval is absent at plan time and must be supplied separately before any signing boundary.
expected_postconditions: Authority binding record is closed and binds authority ID, key ID, key version, public-key digest, purpose, and binding digest.
The exact unsigned lock request remains unchanged until a separately approved signed-environment operation.
No KMS public-key read, signing call, signature, authority promotion, or release lock is performed by this plan.
operations.approval_gate: APPROVAL_REQUIRED:master approves self-custodied authority/KMS binding and separately approves any future Confidential Space signing request; no approval means no-op.
stop_conditions: Key version is not a single EC_SIGN_ED25519 version, public key does not match, or private key material appears.
Unsigned lock or request digest changes.
Any independent evaluator authority, local signature, or production promotion is introduced.
rollback_conditions: If binding digest or public-key verification fails, discard the binding proposal and restore null/unresolved fields.
If signing is ever approved but response verification fails, retain the unsigned request, reject the response, and do not promote or retry with a different key.

rerunnable.existing_match: no-op when exact binding and unsigned request match
rerunnable.drift: fail closed on any key, authority, or lock drift

operations.desired_state_operation: Declare create-only, generation-checked GCS objects for the generated diagnostic bundle, preserving the private case store as private and keeping object upload unapplied.

exact_required_inputs.name: prefix
exact_required_inputs.source: REQUIRED_INPUT:reviewed run prefix below the approved bucket

preconditions: Artifact index and all 11 listed artifacts reproduce exactly from the committed generator; private store remains outside public worker output.
Bucket and prefix are reviewed, private, and within the capability boundary; no list/delete/bucket-admin capability is assumed.
For every object, destination absent is acceptable; an existing object is acceptable only when exact digest and approved generation state match.
Master approval for durable ingestion is present.
expected_postconditions: The desired object set contains exactly the generated artifact index entries under the approved bucket/prefix/run namespace.
Public objects retain their recorded digests; private-truth/case-store.json is private and never exposed to the worker.
Any later apply is create-only or generation-checked and rerunnable; this plan itself performs no upload.
operations.approval_gate: APPROVAL_REQUIRED:master approves bucket, prefix, private-truth handling, and create-only ingestion; no approval means no-op.
stop_conditions: Bucket/prefix is missing, public, outside the reviewed project, or cannot guarantee create-only/generation checks.
Any object digest differs, an object would be overwritten without exact generation precondition, or private truth would be public.
Any GCS upload, delete, list, or credential operation is attempted by local validation.
rollback_conditions: Before apply, discard the proposed object plan on any digest/path mismatch.

After an approved apply, quarantine or remove only resources explicitly owned by the approved IaC state; preserve required evidence and use generation checks. Unknown ownership or generation is a hard stop, not a delete authorization.

rerunnable.existing_match: no-op when every object digest and generation precondition matches
rerunnable.drift: fail closed on any object/path/visibility mismatch

operations.desired_state_operation: Render the existing deployment policy and Cloud Run/Confidential Space desired state with immutable image/runtime/closure commitments, internal ingress, and locked attestation capability boundaries.

exact_required_inputs.name: target_repository
exact_required_inputs.source: RS-069R5 read-only observation: existing approved Artifact Registry repository

exact_required_inputs.name: seccomp_and_closure_digests
exact_required_inputs.source: REQUIRED_INPUT:reviewed seccomp, syscall, host, argv, and closure digests

preconditions: Operations 1-4 have approved, mutually consistent desired inputs.
Existing renderer is services.p5_r0_evaluator.deployments.render_deployment and local preflight_deployment passes with the complete reviewed policy.
Cloud Run remains internal ingress, gen2, maxScale=1, concurrency=1, timeout=30, immutable image, and capability service account is exact/reviewed.
Confidential Space configuration contains no secrets and remains locked until attestation, STS/provider exchange, and bounded capability construction succeed.
expected_postconditions: Local renderer emits metadata, CEL, VM, and Containerfile artifacts with identical digest bindings and no unresolved markers.

Desired Cloud Run state uses internal ingress and immutable image; desired Confidential Space state uses SEV, approved zone, network none, pull never, read-only/drop-all closure, and fixed resource profile.
No Cloud Run deploy, VM create, IAM change, image push, credential generation, KMS, GCS, FreeTSA, or task execution occurs.
operations.approval_gate: APPROVAL_REQUIRED:master approves rendered desired state and separately authorizes the approved IaC workflow; no approval means no-op.
stop_conditions: Any unresolved marker, mutable image, digest mismatch, public ingress, expanded capability, unexpected region/zone, or renderer drift.
Any request to apply Cloud Run, create a VM, alter IAM, or access credentials outside the approved IaC workflow.
Confidential Space startup cannot prove exact claims, provider, image, project, zone, debug-disabled, TEE, secure boot, hardware, and workload.
rollback_conditions: Before apply, discard rendered artifacts and restore unresolved desired-state inputs on any preflight failure.
After approved apply, restore the last approved revision/state only through approved IaC with immutable revision and generation checks; halt if prior state is not known.

rerunnable.existing_match: no-op when rendered desired state and revision fingerprint match
rerunnable.drift: fail closed on remote drift or unknown revision
rerunnable.writes: local render only; cloud apply requires separate approval

operations.desired_state_operation: Prepare one idempotent supervisor/run request bound to the exact diagnostic inputs, signed-environment approval, runtime commitments, and self-custodied authority; do not submit tasks or execute the run.

exact_required_inputs.name: supervisor_id_and_policy
exact_required_inputs.source: REQUIRED_INPUT:approved supervisor identity and RS050 policy

exact_required_inputs.name: signed_environment_approval
exact_required_inputs.source: REQUIRED_INPUT:verified Confidential Space approval record; never locally authored

exact_required_inputs.name: signed_lock_or_approved_signing_response
exact_required_inputs.source: REQUIRED_INPUT:approved response to exact unsigned lock request

exact_required_inputs.name: task_release_authorization
exact_required_inputs.source: REQUIRED_INPUT:master-approved task release; absent in this plan

preconditions: All prior desired-state operations are approved and their exact fingerprints are available.
Supervisor contract validates independently and can fail closed on timeout, descendants, invalid receipts, resource exhaustion, and rollback impasse.
Self-custodied authority is the only authority claim; no independent evaluator claim, timing certification, or positive result claim is enabled.
Task release and execution approval are not present in the checked-in plan.
expected_postconditions: A canonical request can be rendered locally with a stable idempotency key and exact input digests.
Request is blocked until separate master approval and verified Confidential Space approval; no task, supervisor, or worker is invoked.
Any future evidence remains diagnostic and must state what was and was not observed.
operations.approval_gate: APPROVAL_REQUIRED:master separately approves run request and task release; signed-environment attestation must be independently verified; no approval means no-op.
stop_conditions: Missing or locally authored approval, signature, supervisor identity, task release, or runtime commitment.
Any request to execute a task, invoke the supervisor, call an external timing provider, or fabricate evidence.
Any result would imply independent evaluator authority or a production claim.
rollback_conditions: Before submission, discard the request on any digest or approval mismatch.
After an approved run, supervisor timeout/invalid receipt/rollback impasse requires fail-closed termination and approved cleanup; never retry with altered inputs.

rerunnable.existing_match: no-op/replay exact canonical request only; conflicting reuse fails
rerunnable.drift: fail closed on any request, approval, or runtime drift

operations.desired_state_operation: Define an ownership- and generation-checked cleanup/rollback path for the proposed revision, VM/run namespace, and temporary state; preserve required diagnostic evidence and never broaden deletion authority.

exact_required_inputs.name: owned_resource_inventory
exact_required_inputs.source: REQUIRED_INPUT:approved post-apply resource inventory with owner and generation

preconditions: Cleanup is invoked only after an explicit abort, terminal run, failed precondition, or approved rollback decision.
Every resource is proven owned by this plan and matches the approved generation/fingerprint; unknown resources are never touched.
Required diagnostic evidence and private-truth retention rules are known before cleanup; no delete is inferred from absence.
A prior approved state exists before rollback; otherwise stop without mutation.
expected_postconditions: Failed or superseded resources are disabled/restored/retained according to approved IaC state, with no dangling evaluator capability or public ingress.
Private truth remains private; required diagnostic records remain retained or are disposed only under explicit approved policy.
Cleanup is repeatable: already-clean state is a no-op, drift or unknown ownership is a hard stop, and no direct cloud command is embedded.
operations.approval_gate: APPROVAL_REQUIRED:master approves cleanup/rollback scope and retention; no approval means no-op.
stop_conditions: Ownership, generation, prior state, retention, or rollback target is unknown.
Cleanup would touch resources outside the approved run namespace or delete required evidence.
Any direct delete/rollback API or gcloud mutation is proposed by local validation.
rollback_conditions: If cleanup cannot prove exact ownership and generation, do nothing and escalate to master.
If rollback target is unavailable or differs from the approved prior fingerprint, leave resources locked/disabled and report an impasse.

rerunnable.existing_match: no-op when owned desired cleanup state already matches

rerun_contract.ordering: operations execute only in ascending order after dependencies are approved
rerun_contract.idempotency: each operation has a stable key derived from immutable inputs
rerun_contract.drift: unknown or conflicting state fails closed; matching desired state is a no-op
rerun_contract.approval: all mutation-capable transitions are disabled until explicit master approval
rerun_contract.state: desired state is declarative and can be re-rendered without cloud reads or writes
rerun_contract.rollback: rollback is a desired-state proposal through the same approved IaC workflow, not an imperative local command

must_prove: exact operation order and dependency closure
all operation mutation boundaries are no-op until approval
self-custodied authority with no independent evaluator claim
known diagnostic digests match the read-only artifact index
no executable direct gcloud/cloud mutation is embedded

claim_boundary: RS-069 repository desired-state plan only; no production deployment, image binding, WIP/IAM mutation, authority creation, KMS signature, GCS ingestion, Confidential Space activation, supervisor execution, task result, independent evaluator claim, or production evidence exists.
